summary.headline: NHPC Q2 FY27 PAT rose 52% YoY to Rs 1,549 Crore, with Subansiri Lower part-commissioning and higher PAF driving the gain.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue from operations rose 33% YoY to Rs 4,482 Crore and PAT rose 52% to Rs 1,549 Crore, helped by 17% higher generation (13,935 MUs) and a Q2 PAF of 92.24% versus 78.58%. Management said a Rs 231 Crore Teesta-IV provision is the only one-off, which would lift adjusted PAT to roughly Rs 1,700 Crore. Finance cost and depreciation roughly doubled as Subansiri Lower's interest and depreciation moved into P&L after part-commissioning. Trade receivables rose to Rs 4,283 Crore at 30 September, but management said only Rs 1,159 Crore was outstanding on 3 November, with Rs 6 Crore beyond 45 days.

segments.name: Hydro generation (fleet)
segments.commentary: H1 generation 23,741 MUs (+14%, +2,875 MUs); Q2 generation 13,935 MUs (+17%). H1 PAF 86.67% vs 81.10%; Q2 PAF 92.24% vs 78.58%.

segments.name: Subansiri Lower (2,000 MW)
segments.commentary: Five of eight 250 MW units commissioned (1,250 MW), latest on 23 Oct 2026; contributed Rs 132 Crore PBT in Q2 and about Rs 170 Crore in H1. Cost Rs 30,072 Crore, Rs 26,936 Crore spent to Sep 2026.

segments.name: Parbati-II and Parbati-III
segments.commentary: Parbati-II PBT Rs 215 Crore in Q2 vs a loss of Rs 164 Crore a year earlier; Parbati-III added Rs 80 Crore PBT. Parbati-II revenue is recognised at 80% pending final CERC tariff.

segments.name: Teesta-V (commercial operation resumed July 2026)
segments.commentary: Generated 859 MUs in Q2 with top line of about Rs 150-160 Crore and PBT of Rs 99 Crore. Management guided H2 PBT of Rs 100-150 Crore.

segments.name: Solar (NHPC RE)
segments.commentary: Bikaner 300 MW commissioned; 1,190 MW under construction. Andhra Pradesh 100 MW guided Jan 2027, Gujarat 600 MW Nov 2027; delays attributed to connectivity.

guidance_outlook: FY27 capex target Rs 14,300 Crore; Rs 6,500 Crore achieved till the call, with management expecting the target to be met on stronger H2 spend.
Next year onward, consolidated capex averaging Rs 14,000-15,000 Crore per year; 10-year capex plan about Rs 1,11,000 Crore with about Rs 40,000 Crore equity need (about Rs 4,000 Crore a year).
FY27 capacity additions guided at 1,744 MW: 500 MW Subansiri (already commissioned), 624 MW Kiru and 120 MW Rangit-IV; FY28 about 250 MW Subansiri plus 1,000 MW Pakal Dul.
Management expects FY28 PAT of Rs 6,000-6,400 Crore and EBITDA near Rs 10,000 Crore on full-year Subansiri and Pakal Dul commissioning, versus Rs 6,000-7,000 Crore currently.
Teesta-V H2 PBT guided at Rs 100-150 Crore, based on generation similar to Q2 (859 MUs).
Adjusted Q2 PAT guided to about 90% YoY growth on a standalone basis, versus 65% shared earlier, after adding back the Rs 231 Crore Teesta-IV provision.

adds.what: Subansiri Lower 2,000 MW: 5 of 8 units (1,250 MW) commissioned, latest 23 Oct 2026; 2 more units in FY27, last by June 2027
Kiru hydro 624 MW guided for FY27
Pakal Dul 1,000 MW: two units by March 2027, full by June 2027
Solar: 1,190 MW under construction; Andhra Pradesh 100 MW guided Jan 2027, Gujarat 600 MW Nov 2027

growth.why: FY28 PAT guided at Rs 6,000-6,400 Cr (vs Rs 6,000-7,000 Cr currently, a range that implies flat-to-lower) on full-year Subansiri and Pakal Dul commissioning; FY27 capacity additions of 1,744 MW (Subansiri, Kiru, Rangit-IV) with specific unit timelines, though Subansiri's last unit slipped to June 2027 and Pakal Dul targets are firm only for March/June 2027.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Subansiri Lower contributing Rs 132 Cr PBT in Q2 and FY28 EBITDA guided near Rs 10,000 Cr vs Rs 6,000-7,000 Cr now, though Q2 incentives fell to Rs 59 Cr from Rs 253 Cr and finance cost doubled to Rs 556 Cr.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: 1,744 MW guided for FY27 (500 MW Subansiri already commissioned, 624 MW Kiru, 120 MW Rangit-IV) plus 1,000 MW Pakal Dul with two units by March 2027, though Subansiri's last unit slipped to June 2027 and solar Gujarat 600 MW is set for Nov 2027.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Q2 generation up 17% to 13,935 MUs and H1 PAF 86.67% vs 81.10%, with new units adding capacity; FY28 PAT guided Rs 6,000-6,400 Cr on full-year Subansiri and Pakal Dul.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: FY27 capex target Rs 14,300 Cr with Rs 6,500 Cr spent to date, and 10-year plan of about Rs 1,11,000 Cr with Rs 14,000-15,000 Cr a year from next year, so new project approvals are a continuing flow rather than a discrete trigger.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY28 PAT guide of Rs 6,000-6,400 Cr sits within the current Rs 6,000-7,000 Cr range, so the call points to flat-to-lower rather than an upgrade.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Subansiri's last unit has slipped to June 2027 and solar Andhra Pradesh and Gujarat depend on connectivity, with Parbati-II tariff order pending after the 11 Nov hearing and Rs 6,500 Cr of Rs 14,300 Cr capex spent by mid-year.

rows.label: Parbati-II CERC final tariff order
rows.why: Parbati-II revenue is recognised at 80% pending final tariff, with hearing fixed 11 Nov 2026 and Q2 Parbati-II PBT at Rs 215 Cr vs a loss of Rs 164 Cr a year earlier.

rows.label: Teesta-V H2 PBT of Rs 100-150 Cr
rows.why: Teesta-V generated 859 MUs in Q2 after commercial operation resumed in July 2026, with Q2 PBT at Rs 99 Cr and H2 guided at Rs 100-150 Cr.

rows.label: Receivables collection
rows.why: Only Rs 1,159 Cr of Rs 4,283 Cr receivables outstanding at 3 Nov 2026 with Rs 6 Cr beyond 45 days, though unbilled stands at Rs 1,573 Cr.

tone.note: Management was confident on generation, PAF and the Subansiri and Pakal Dul timelines, and cautious on the Subansiri last-unit slip and solar connectivity delays; the brief records no analyst Q&A detail.
